分析代码

1 个源码文件，按目录顺序；本机绝对路径已替换为 ~。 代码可复制，但需要按自己的数据改路径与参数。

step1_convert_seurat2_h5ad.r r · 647 bytes 
setwd("/Volumes/Seagate Basic/精品代码/111_celloracle实战GRN网络构建")
library(Seurat)
library(scop)
library(scCustomize)
pbmc <- readRDS("pbmc3k.RDS")
dim(pbmc)
CellDimPlot(pbmc,group.by = 'celltype')

pbmc <- FindVariableFeatures(pbmc,nfeatures = 3000)

VariableFeatures(pbmc)[1:3000]

gene <- VariableFeatures(pbmc)[1:3000]

pbmc <- pbmc[gene,]
dim(pbmc)

DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- 'RNA'
dim(pbmc)
# 假设你的 Seurat 对象名为 seurat_obj
as.anndata(x = pbmc, file_path = "./", 
           file_name = "pbmc.h5ad", assay = "RNA", main_layer = "counts", 
           other_layers = c("data"), transfer_dimreduc = TRUE, verbose = TRUE)
